intro: The Haldarr Encampment is a corrupted satyr outpost nestled in western Azshara, situated northeast of the Shadowsong Shrine and southwest of Valormok. Densely inhabited by the vicious Haldarr satyrs, it stands as a dangerous blight among the ancient elven ruins. It is also the site where an injured Night Elf Sentinel, Keldara Sunblade, is held captive.

p: Perched among the broken stones of western Azshara, the Haldarr Encampment serves as a gathering ground for the Haldarr clan of satyrs. These twisted creatures, ancient remnants of the Highborne cursed by demonic corruption during the Sundering, actively hunt and harass any who traverse the autumn forests. The dense settlement poses an ongoing threat to both the Horde forces stationed at nearby Valormok and the dwindling Night Elf sentinels trying to monitor the region.
